messages:
incident-bot: P0 PAGE: service-discovery degradation in us-west-1b · incident=INC-2026-0427-07 · paging: @alice-oncall @bob-sre
alice-oncall: acknowledged. jumping in. quick health checks now.
bob-sre: CoreDNS exceptions and SRV lookup timeouts from pods in us-west-1b; spike in NSE errors and socket errors on coredns nodes.
chandra-runtime: any config pushes recently? I see a consul TTL tuning landed this morning.
deploy-bot: deploy: 2026-04-27T08:59:02Z — consul-operator v1.8.0 applied (change: ttl-backoff tuning, experimental-cache=true) to region us-west
dana-support: customers reporting 502s and service discovery timeouts. currently 11 tickets, marking high priority tenants.
eli-network: network telemetry shows packet loss between us-west-1b compute and control-plane endpoints. possible local routing flap; BGP AS path churn observed.
alice-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) divert control-plane DNS queries away from problematic AZ 1b to 1a 2) reduce DNS QPS via client retry gating 3) quick CoreDNS config tweak to increase concurrent handlers and forward to healthy upsteam
alice-oncall: applying config edit:
```
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap coredns-uswest1b --patch '
{"data": {"Corefile": "\n.:53 {\n    errors\n    health\n    ready\n    forward . 10.0.1.10 10.0.1.11\n    max_concurrent 200\n}\n"}}'
```
bob-sre: reverting experimental-cache flag for us-west-1b consul via: `consul kv put config/experimental_cache false`
chandra-runtime: enabling short-lived routing preference to avoid 1b for 20m: policy apply prefer-us-west-1a ttl=20m
eli-network: opened ticket with cloud provider for AZ peering instability; added iptables qdisc to rate-limit noisy retries on affected hosts to avoid socket exhaustion.
dana-support: sent customer advisory. ETA 30m for stabilization. flagged top 5 customers for direct updates.
bob-sre: rolling restart of coredns daemonset in us-west-1b: `kubectl rollout restart ds/coredns-uswest1b -n kube-system` — pods came back healthy.
alice-oncall: metrics: SRV errors down from 14% -> 2.1% over 5m; p50 latency 500ms -> 110ms. keeping channel open for handoff.
incident-manager: assigning long-term RCA to @bob-sre, networking followup to @eli-network. on-call coverage: @alice-oncall next 90m.
eli-network: provider confirms BGP flap on us-west-1b external fabric — fix applied ~09:11Z, flaps stopped ~09:13Z. provider incident ref: https://cloud.example/INC-az-98765
alice-oncall: starting handoff note: summary + actions + artifact locations. leaving channel 09:20Z — handing to @bob-sre for post-incident.
bob-sre: collecting CoreDNS logs, consul metrics, tcpdumps. uploading to /incidents/INC-2026-0427-07/artifacts. will draft RCA and follow up with provider on peering SLA.
dana-support: final customer update posted: majority auto-recovered after 09:13Z, peak affected sessions ~280, no data loss, follow-ups queued.
incident-bot: INCIDENT status -> mitigated at 1876543275 · severity P2 (followup)
alice-oncall: great work team. postmortem owner: @bob-sre — initial draft due EOD.
